example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মৃত্যুর পর পরিবারের সকলে তিনাঞ্জলি দিয়ে শোক প্রকাশ করল।
যুদ্ধক্ষেত্রে বীরের মৃত্যুতে সৈন্যরা তিনাঞ্জলি অর্পণ করল।
example_sentences_in_english: The family offered তিনাঞ্জলি to express their grief after his death.
The soldiers gave a final farewell to the brave warrior on the battlefield.
history: Originates from the Hindu ritual of tarpan, where water is offered three times to appease the departed soul during shraddha ceremonies.
note: Closely related to the synonymous idiom তিলাঞ্জলি, both evoking themes of permanent separation through death.
